exposure: Infant admitted to NICU or WBN
outcome: Maternal knowledge of delivery mode safety
Maternal knowledge of elective late preterm delivery risks
cohort: Mothers of newborns admitted to either a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) (n=88) or a well-baby nursery (WBN) (n=145) between March 2008 and September 2010.
finding: Significant gaps exist in mothers' understanding of the medical implications of premature delivery and delivery mode, and these knowledge gaps are primarily influenced by socioeconomic and demographic factors rather than the location of their infant.
